question.text: Can a simple character n-gram classifier expose edition and translation fingerprint leakage in the preserved v0.1 corpus?

hypothesis: Character 3–5 gram TF-IDF will outperform a majority baseline because editorial and translation fingerprints leak edition identity.

criteria: Treat the result only as an edition-fingerprint leakage diagnostic.
Reject any cultural-origin, authenticity, motif, or tale-type inference.

time.rationale: The preserved historical classifier run did not record wall-clock time.

compute.rationale: The preserved historical classifier run did not record CPU consumption.

limitations: The held-out test contains only 12 documents.
Perfect edition attribution measures editorial and translation leakage, not folklore understanding.
This v2 record migrates metadata around preserved v1 evidence; it does not claim a rerun.

decision.rationale: Retain the experiment as a leakage diagnostic and reject the candidate for folklore classification.
